findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vendor_trust_profile, agentic_commerce_readiness, find_best_api, email_domain_check, read_url, search_guides, get_guide, ai_visibility_score, check_ai_crawler_access · Private data: vendor_trust_profile, agentic_commerce_readiness, company_profile, check_before_paying, find_best_api, email_domain_check, generate_llms_txt · Public sink: why_is_it_moving, find_best_api, email_domain_check, get_guide · Destructive: check_before_paying, package_check, generate_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vendor_trust_profile, agentic_commerce_readiness, find_best_api, email_domain_check, read_url, search_guides, get_guide, ai_visibility_score, check_ai_crawler_access · Private data: vendor_trust_profile, agentic_commerce_readiness, company_profile, check_before_paying, find_best_api, email_domain_check, generate_llms_txt · Public sink: why_is_it_moving, find_best_api, email_domain_check, get_guide · Destructive: check_before_paying, package_check, generate_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_guides" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
